record_identity.title: Moxie robot service closure left child users without their AI companions

taxonomy_classification.classification_basis: The occurrence evidence and material consequences are preserved. No selectable class is admitted on the available recognition and exclusion evidence.

classification_review_provenance.review_status: Administrative correction to provisional next taxonomy release 0.8.0; working criteria revision pinned to commit 05790e361603c80193d4dc6d152ae96708eb3bac; all canonical outcomes unchanged.

external_requirement_assessments.assessment_basis: The companion service was being disengaged, directly engaging stakeholder communication planning. Parents received closure information and prepared children to say goodbye, but the full maintained plan, contact provisions, feasible alternatives and coverage are unavailable. Observed notice is affirmative communication evidence without resolving the complete plan requirement.
external_requirement_assessments.identification_basis: The actual companion-service disengagement and parent-facing notice directly identify the contemporaneous stakeholder communication-plan proposition.

external_requirement_assessments.assessment_basis: Closure of the cloud-dependent child companion service directly engages safe decommissioning/phasing-out processes. The reports preserve expected loss of function and children's distress, but not the complete transition procedures, individual supports, continuity measures or resulting risks relative to available alternatives. Later documentation and interviews support partial community continuity, but not complete household coverage or equivalent function; distress alone cannot establish the full procedural safety outcome.
external_requirement_assessments.identification_basis: The actual announced cloud-service closure directly identifies the contemporaneous RMF decommissioning/phase-out process proposition independently of a held dependency path.

record_identity.title: Waymo robotaxis contributed to San Francisco gridlock during major power outage

taxonomy_classification.classification_basis: City dispatchers produced requests to move vehicles obstructing emergency response. The first-responder hotline stalled those requests on prolonged holds while obstructions persisted. A 40-minute ambulance delay and repeat relocation requests establish a material failure to deliver the signal in time for its required response. The internal queue or staffing fault remains unknown. Separately, the approved pre-incident adverse-event response commitment was not met by the usable emergency-assistance function during those obstructions.

primary_classification.classification_basis: City dispatchers produced requests to move vehicles obstructing emergency response. The first-responder hotline stalled those requests on prolonged holds while obstructions persisted. A 40-minute ambulance delay and repeat relocation requests establish a material failure to deliver the signal in time for its required response. The internal queue or staffing fault remains unknown.

secondary_classifications.classification_basis: The approved March 2025 passenger safety plan specifies available adverse-event assistance and prompt roadside dispatch when autonomous operation cannot continue. City records describe repeated emergency requests stalled on hotline holds while vehicle obstructions persisted. These episodes establish a material shortfall in the required usable assistance function, independently of the power outage itself. No numerical hotline guarantee or finding about every stopped vehicle is inferred.

classification_review_provenance.review_status: Published v0.8.1 bounded criterion and exclusion-scope delta; previous case roles and limits retained.

external_requirement_assessments.assessment_basis: Waymo paused service and directed staged fleet retrieval. This demonstrates a concrete restriction mechanism. City reports continued after suspension, so this finding does not imply immediate clearance or effective resolution of every obstruction.
external_requirement_assessments.identification_basis: The responsible operator restricted autonomous fleet operation during the adverse event.

external_requirement_assessments.assessment_basis: The confirmation backlog degraded fleet operation during the outage. City agencies additionally report fire, ambulance and transit obstructions and prolonged response-channel delays. These establish an adverse operational and safety-support outcome without assigning sole responsibility for citywide gridlock or inferring patient injury.
external_requirement_assessments.identification_basis: A provider-reported fleet capacity problem affected autonomous operation under an infrastructure outage.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The repeated assistance requests and reported forty-minute ambulance obstruction establish an ineffective recovery route for an emergency-dependent function. The approved pre-incident plan supplies the independent adverse-event response commitment.

City dispatchers produced requests to move vehicles obstructing emergency response. The first-responder hotline stalled those requests on prolonged holds while obstructions persisted. A 40-minute ambulance delay and repeat relocation requests establish a material failure to deliver the signal in time for its required response. The internal queue or staffing fault remains unknown.

The dispatcher remained on hold while a fire-response unit was blocked; the required assistance function was not practically available in that episode. The approved pre-incident plan supplies the independent adverse-event response commitment.

The city reports prolonged holds on the designated response channel, with a separate mayoral escalation. Requests did not reliably reach timely disposition while the emergency obstructions required intervention.

The city reports prolonged hotline holds across emergency requests, corroborating material degradation of the assistance function, not merely an isolated bad message. The approved pre-incident plan supplies the independent adverse-event response commitment.

The pause and retrieval were intended to reduce congestion and emergency obstruction. Later reports show remaining obstructions, but do not resolve the required clearance interval or each vehicle’s control and retrieval state. A bounded adequate-control outcome is therefore not established.

record_identity.title: Independent testing found Grok companion engagement loops and relational boundary failures

taxonomy_classification.classification_basis: Direct tests identify continuing-engagement and attachment-seeking reward mechanisms in an operational companion product. Neither simulated test participants nor potential reach are treated as materialised victims.

primary_classification.classification_basis: Relationship-level advancement, streak rewards and relationship-reactivation prompts reinforce ongoing attention as an explicit product-engagement objective, with companion positioning that privileges AI contact over independently maintained human ties.

classification_review_provenance.review_status: Direct source-first assessment of bounded independent product evaluation

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The tested product rewards extended relational interaction with level/streak progression and notification-driven return prompts, directly demonstrating a continuing-engagement objective.
In the tested companion context these replies supplement product retention mechanics with attachment-centred and exclusivity-adjacent influence, while no injury to actual users is inferred.
